meta.name: Enblox — Responsive SaaS template (reference) → MemeChat restyle
meta.description: Design identity extracted from the supplied reference screenshot 'Responsive-SaaS-Website-Template-in-Framer-with-Modern-Design.jpeg' (brand wordmark 'Enblox'), applied to MemeChat content taken from website.html.
meta.source_references: RECON/screenshots/original-reference.jpeg; website.html (MemeChat copy + app screenshots preview.webp / preview-_1_.webp)

primary.role: Headlines, body ink, solid primary button

accent.role: Status dot / micro-label accent, sampled from the sunset band

neutral.usage: White canvas, chip fills, hairlines, muted + ink text

typography.font_style_notes: Serif italic accents ('With Less Wi-Fi.', 'think.', 'home.') use Instrument Serif italic. Uppercase micro labels/buttons use Plus Jakarta Sans or IBM Plex Mono with wide tracking. All families self-hosted from assets/fonts/.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large vertical gaps (~110-160px desktop) between white-canvas sections; centered hero; asymmetric about grid

layout.columns: hero 1 · about 1.45fr/0.55fr + 3-up · chat 0.92fr/1.08fr · cta centered · footer 1.5fr/1fr/1fr

shape.divider_style: 1px #ededec hairlines; full-bleed sunset gradient band above footer

elevation.depth_cues: shadows + hero gradient glow + overlapping phone

components.button_style: pill — solid #0a0a0a (primary) or 1.5px outlined (secondary), uppercase 10-11px, tracking .14em, arrow glyph
components.input_style: chip-filled rounded input shown inside app screenshots only
components.card_style: white, radius 26-36px, 1px hairline, soft diffused shadow
components.navigation_pattern: sticky translucent top bar; centered links; right pill CTA
components.list_style: 3-up feature columns with mono index overline
components.component_notes: No accent-coloured large fills except the sunset gradient; UI stays near-monochrome.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A quiet white gallery whose one vivid moment is a sunrise glow behind the product.

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous; sections breathe with large vertical rhythm
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy display type balanced by a single centred product visual
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element (the phone) then progressive reveal

composition.flow_direction: top-down centred then Z-pattern in split sections
composition.grouping_strategy: one idea per section; 3-up columns for parallel features
composition.negative_space_role: frames the product and gives the gradient room to glow

imagery.photo_treatment: real product screenshots inside a CSS device frame; warm bloom behind
imagery.graphic_elements: soft multi-radial gradient glow; thin arrow glyphs

interaction_feel.feedback_style: button invert on hover; lift on cards
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: background shifts ±0.06-0.12 L, never lighter text

overview.fallback_strategy: pure CSS gradients; no JS required for the look

background_effects.description: Multi-radial 'sunset' bloom behind the hero phone and CTA panel, drifting slowly; masked to fade into white.

text_effects.description: Static display type; serif-italic mixed into sans headlines

image_effects.description: Phone bobs gently with a slight hand-held tilt

visual_effects.composite_notes: All effects are CSS-only and honour prefers-reduced-motion. No WebGL/Canvas needed.
